accessibility: Migrate to canonical Rating and preserve its one named star image, decorative shape-distinct stars, independently readable optional count, and passive semantics.
Do not restore the star-rating selector, add a compatibility alias, or use the passive display for value entry.
Use Star Input for interactive rating selection.

web.notes: Temporary migration records render canonical A11 Rating; V2 owns no Web implementation.

shopify.notes: Use the existing canonical Rating Liquid projection; V2 owns no Shopify adapter.
